items.name: glass-style
items.title: Glass style
items.description: The design tokens (frost, rim, highlight, shadow, blur, saturation, fill, aurora, liquid, clarity, labels, status), the material utilities (glass / glass-strong / glass-subtle), the liquid control-layer utilities (glass-liquid / glass-liquid-clear), focus, hit-area, concentric corners, Apple text styles, accessibility overrides, aurora and draw keyframes, a no-backdrop-filter fallback, and glassVariants — the cva every surface shares.
items.docs: glasscn is installed. Put <Aurora /> (shadcn add @glasscn-app/aurora) behind your app, and make sure your global CSS has @import "tw-animate-css"; (shadcn init adds it) so overlays animate.

items.name: glass-theme
items.title: Theme engine
items.description: The schema of every glass primitive, the palettes and presets, a hue-harmony palette generator, and exports to CSS, inline style, a shadcn theme item and a share code — with value sanitising and a legibility estimate.

items.name: use-sliding-indicator
items.title: useSlidingIndicator
items.description: Exposes the selected child's box as CSS variables so one element can slide between items — the moving thumb in segmented controls, tabs and the dock.

items.name: use-glass-pointer
items.title: useGlassPointer
items.description: Feeds liquid glass from the pointer: --glass-press-x/y for the glass-illuminate press glow, and optionally turns the rim's light toward a hovering pointer. rAF-batched, no React state.

items.name: glass-charts
items.title: Chart maths
items.description: Pure maths for the data components: ring radii and arcs, scaled series, smooth Catmull-Rom paths and areas, the heatmap week grid, bar shares, gauge arcs and category segments.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: The living ground: three palette blobs drifting over the base colour. Pure CSS, reduced-motion aware.

items.name: backdrop
items.title: Backdrop
items.description: A ground for glass besides the aurora: a photo with an optional scrim, a muted looping video (paused under reduced motion), a palette mesh, or a fine noise.

items.name: glass
items.title: Glass
items.description: A glass pane — material (content) or liquid (control layer, regular or clear). Intensity, tint and elevation variants; asChild.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: shadcn's Card API on glass: header, title, description, action, content, footer, a hero image — regular, thick or solid material, and asChild for a pressable link card.

items.name: theme-scope
items.title: Theme scope
items.description: Re-theme a subtree at runtime: a different palette, material, shape or scheme for one card, section or preview.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Heading, Text, Display, Blockquote, InlineCode, List and TextLink on the theme's modular scale — fonts, weights, case and numerals from the type tokens.

items.name: prose
items.title: Prose
items.description: Rich text (Markdown, MDX, CMS) set in the theme's type: headings, links, lists, quotes, code, tables.

& :where(pre).background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--glass-tinted, var(--glass-tint)) calc(var(--glass-opacity-subtle) * min(1, var(--glass-clarity) * 2) + (100% - var(--glass-opacity-subtle)) * max(0, var(--glass-clarity) * 2 - 1)), transparent)
& :where(pre).border: var(--glass-border-width) solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--glass-border-color) var(--glass-border-opacity), transparent)

& :where(kbd).border: var(--glass-border-width) solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent)

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: shadcn's Button with liquid glass, prominent (tinted liquid), tinted and secondary variants; capsule or rounded, elastic press, a loading state, pull-down and split buttons.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small capsule labels: solid, tinted, glass, secondary, outline, destructive.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A filled field for glass: soft fill, accent caret and focus ring.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A filled, auto-growing text area for glass.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: An accessible label.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: The iOS 27 switch: a wide capsule fills with the accent; the knob stretches toward where it's going, turns into a lens while held and can be dragged.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: shadcn's Checkbox on glass: a soft box that fills with the accent, with an indeterminate dash.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: The iOS segmented control: one concentric thumb slides to the chosen segment and can be dragged across them as a lens; capsule or rounded, or momentary actions.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs with a sliding pill (glass capsule, plain) or a sliding underline.

items.name: glass-group
items.title: Glass group
items.description: One shared liquid backdrop for neighbouring controls (Apple's GlassEffectContainer), with an optional selection that slides and morphs between them.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A soft track, an accent range and capsule knobs that turn into lenses while dragged. Ranges, ticks, a neutral origin, end icons, a value bubble and a thumbless progress variant.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A capsule bar filling from the second chart colour into the accent.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keycaps on glass, singly or grouped.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline that reads on glass.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: shadcn's Avatar on glass: a round photo with a hairline rim, initials on a soft fill, and overlapping groups.

items.name: glass-preferences
items.title: Glass preferences
items.description: The viewer's Liquid Glass setting: a Clarity slider (clear ↔ tinted) and a Reduce transparency switch that write --glass-clarity for the whole page, persisted, with a head script that applies it before paint.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A liquid-glass modal over a dimmed page that morphs out of its trigger (View Transitions) or materialises in place.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: An Apple-style alert on strong glass: a bold title, a short message and capsule actions — for confirming destructive or irreversible choices. Only its buttons close it.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A floating glass panel that slides in from any edge, inset like an iPad sheet — with detents, a grabber, drag-to-dismiss and a non-modal inspector mode.

items.name: action-sheet
items.title: Action sheet
items.description: The iOS action sheet: a few choices in one liquid group rising from the bottom, Cancel in its own capsule — on the alert-dialog primitives.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Floating glass content anchored to a trigger.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A small glass capsule on hover and focus.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A glass menu: items, checkbox and radio items, labels, shortcuts, submenus.

items.name: toaster
items.title: Toaster
items.description: Sonner toasts dressed in glass: bottom-right on wide screens, top-centre on phones, clear of the Dock and a top Toolbar.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: The floating tab bar: a liquid capsule of destinations with a sliding pill and badges, drag-to-scrub, minimize on scroll, an accessory, a search tab and a tinted action button.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A floating toolbar on the control layer: button groups sharing one liquid capsule, spacers, a title, an overflow menu, a prominent action and minimize on scroll.

items.name: scroll-edge
items.title: Scroll edge
items.description: Keeps bars legible over scrolling content — a progressive blur or a hard strip — and tells the bars when content is under them.

items.name: navigation-bar
items.title: Navigation bar
items.description: iOS's navigation bar: a large title that scrolls away into a small inline one, leading and trailing slots.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A floating, inset liquid sidebar: collapsible, two levels, an overlay on phones, and BackgroundExtension to run media under it.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: A capsule search field: clear and cancel, a minimized button that morphs open, suggestions, and a bottom placement that rides the keyboard.

items.name: grouped-list
items.title: Grouped list
items.description: iOS Settings-style inset grouped rows on glass: headers, footers, icon tiles, values, chevrons.

items.name: activity-rings
items.title: Activity rings
items.description: Apple's Activity rings: an angular gradient along each arc, round caps, endless laps past 100% with a shadow under the leading cap, and a glyph per ring. Server-component safe.

items.name: progress-ring
items.title: Progress ring
items.description: One ring that closes around its content — a goal, a countdown, a seal.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A smooth measure over time that draws itself, with a soft area and the latest point lit.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A figure on a fill tile (glass when standalone): label, value, trend with sentiment, a description, a chart slot, compact formatting and a skeleton.

items.name: kpi
items.title: KPI
items.description: A key figure from Stat: compact value, a trend coloured by whether up is good, context and a sparkline slot — or a skeleton while it loads.

items.name: widget
items.title: Widget
items.description: Glanceable widgets at Apple's sizes — small, medium, large, extra large and the lock-screen circular, rectangular and inline — laid out by container queries, with an accented mode.

items.name: range-chart
items.title: Range chart
items.description: Low-to-high capsules on a shared scale with a current dot — Weather's ten-day temperatures, Health's heart-rate ranges. Server-component safe.

items.name: bar-list
items.title: Bar list
items.description: Ranked horizontal bars with the label inside and the value at the end — top habits, sources, pages.

items.name: gauge
items.title: Gauge
items.description: A three-quarter meter with an optional target tick and the figure in its bowl. Server-component safe.

items.name: tracker
items.title: Tracker
items.description: A row of status blocks — uptime, or a habit's last 30 days.

items.name: category-bar
items.title: Category bar
items.description: A range split into coloured bands with a marker — a readiness score, a budget.

items.name: heatmap
items.title: Heatmap
items.description: Days in week columns coloured by intensity — a contribution graph with month and weekday labels and a legend.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: The chart host: TanStack Charts in a container that maps glass tokens — eight series colours, a glass-strong tooltip, Apple-style axes — plus loading/empty/error states, ChartDataTable and ChartSummary text alternatives, a legend and stable accessors.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area chart
items.description: Volume over time: gradient areas under a line per series — stacked (diverging for negatives) or 100% — with scrubbing, selection and a grouped glass tooltip.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Amounts per category, grouped or stacked with separators, vertical or horizontal, theme-rounded bar ends and a selected bar.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line chart
items.description: Measures over time, one smooth (or stepped) line per series, with scrubbing, selection, a grouped glass tooltip and a crosshair.

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut chart
items.description: Parts of a whole as a ring of rounded slices: an "Other" past eight, a selected slice in the hole, legend values and shares in your locale.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: shadcn's Table for glass: hairline rows, fill on hover and selection, muted headers, density-aware cells.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: shadcn's data table as one component on TanStack Table v9: search, faceted filters, column visibility, selection, rows per page — controlled, server (manual) and virtual modes, loading and error rows.

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: A conversation in parts: a thread that sticks to the latest message, user and assistant bubbles that group into runs, receipts, day dividers, typing dots, quick replies and a composer where Enter sends.

items.name: chat-markdown
items.title: Chat markdown
items.description: Streaming-safe Markdown for chat replies — unclosed fences and marks closed as tokens arrive, GitHub tables and task lists — and ChatCodeBlock with language, copy, wrap and optional Shiki highlighting.

items.name: chat-parts
items.title: Chat parts
items.description: AI SDK UIMessage parts on glass: reasoning ("Thought for 12s"), tool calls with approve/deny, sources and citations, files and attachment chips, errors with retry, message actions, reactions — and renderParts(message).

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A cmdk command palette: a search capsule, groups, fill rows and shortcuts — CommandDialog floats it in a liquid panel for ⌘K.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable select (Popover + Command): single, or multiple with removable chips — a token field.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: react-day-picker on glass: circular days, an accent today, capsule-ended ranges, dropdown captions, RTL.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A date, range or date-and-time behind a button — iOS's compact accent capsule or a form field — opening a calendar in a liquid popover; minute steps that divide 60.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder: a fill with a soft shimmer, still under reduced motion.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: shadcn's Select on glass: a field trigger, a liquid list that grows out of it with a leading check, groups and labels — or a pill pop-up button showing the current choice.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: shadcn's RadioGroup on glass: accent circles with a dot, 44pt hit areas, and a card variant where the whole tile selects.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: shadcn's Field: label, control, description and error laid out together — and wired: ids, htmlFor, aria-describedby and aria-invalid. Sets, legends, groups, horizontal rows.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: One filled field holding an input or textarea and addons: a search icon, units, clear, password reveal, a submit capsule.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Buttons joined into one control — shared corners, hairlines between, either orientation — or floating on one liquid capsule like an Apple toolbar group.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group

items.name: stepper

items.name: drawer

items.name: context-menu

items.name: confirmation-popover

items.name: scroll-area

items.description: shadcn's ScrollArea with capsule thumbs that read on glass, a focusable viewport and optional faded edges.

items.name: accordion

items.name: collapsible

items.name: alert
